title: Worldgen+
description: A refreshed take on Minecraft’s world generation, adding expansive terrain, diverse biomes, and immersive structures to make every world feel new and worth exploring.
body:
![WORLDGEN+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a506848753b5f63249767ad78fdb1776c5dd034.png)

Worldgen+ is my first modpack, built around one simple idea:  
Make Minecraft’s world feel bigger, more alive, and actually worth exploring again.

Vanilla worlds are fun, but after a while they start to feel predictable. This pack changes that by completely reworking world generation without turning the game into something unrecognizable. Mountains feel massive, biomes feel distinct, and structures show up in ways that make exploration genuinely exciting again.

You won’t find complicated systems or heavy gameplay changes here. The goal is simple:  
**a better world to explore, while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact.**

---

![What To Expect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df38c1e701f78dc544d4886ee44b2fba619a315d.png)
- Huge, more natural-looking terrain
- Biomes that feel unique and varied
- Structures that blend into the world instead of feeling random
- A world that rewards going in a random direction just to see what’s there

Every new world feels different, and that’s the whole point.

---

![Mods Included](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cdcdaf1d7748699970b76d2c608de9d06f4f377.png)

This pack is built using a carefully selected set of mods that work together to reshape the world:

- Biomes O’ Plenty  
- Cloth Config  
- EntityCulling  
- FabricAPI  
- FerriteCore  
- GlitchCore  
- ImmediatelyFast
- Incendium  
- Jade  
- Lithium  
- Lithostitched  
- Nullscape  
- SereneSeasons  
- Sodium  
- Structure
- Structure: Towers  
- TerraBlender  
- Terralith  
- Visuality  

---

![Notes From The Creator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3ca01807679375b23eb3425618e5b07cd64ebc1.png)
- This is my **first modpack**, so feedback is genuinely appreciated.
- Best experienced on a **new world**  
- Designed to stay close to vanilla while making exploration feel fresh again  

---

If you’ve ever opened a new world and wished it felt more exciting, this is for you.
